# yyjson (vendored)

Version: **0.13.0** (stable GitHub release, 2026-09-08).
Upstream: https://github.com/ibireme/yyjson/releases/tag/0.13.0

The unmodified upstream `src/yyjson.c` and `src/yyjson.h` are stored here
alongside the upstream MIT `LICENSE`. They are built as a separate static
CMake target (`yyjson`), without downloading anything during the build.

The Goat-specific strict descriptor validator is in `src/module/`.
